summary: picasso-plugin-hammer trojan: preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated math_init.js
details: This package impersonates Qlik's legitimate picasso-plugin-hammer (correct name, author, repository, and a genuine dist/picasso-hammer.js as cover) but adds a preinstall lifecycle hook `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts and chmods the `bun` binary in a temp directory, and invokes it via execFileSync against the sibling file math_init.js shipped in the tarball. math_init.js is a 727 KB single-line, string-array-rotation obfuscated Bun-cjs bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, hex-named identifiers) unrelated to the advertised HammerJS plugin and undocumented in the upstream Qlik repository. Fetching a second language runtime specifically to execute an opaque in-tarball payload at install time evades Node-based install-time scanners and yields arbitrary code execution on the installer's host on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
